question: Under the weighting W(r) (the first r kinds of one uniform random order of the 171 knot kinds in [0,2] x [-2,2]), how often is a random periodic not-all-equal base tied along a shift, travelling (a pattern forcing its own translate, tied along none), or neither, for r = 1 to 8?

definitions.W(r): sample i = 0..199: random.Random(50000 + i).sample(KINDS, 8); base at r = first r kinds
definitions.outcome: contradiction: no state on the 15 x 19 window; base: a doubly periodic state for periods (P,0),(s,Q) as in census.py; else unsettled
definitions.tied along t: window SAT: the value at the origin forces the value at t, t in SHIFTS
definitions.travels: A of 2..4 cells of [0,1] x [0,2] holding (0,0), p on A, t in SHIFTS, sigma: p forces sigma(p) on A + t (window SAT); certified when p with sigma(p) on A+t is carried by a doubly periodic state and A is free (every pattern carried)
definitions.classes: contradiction; tied (tied along a listed shift); travels (certified, tied along none); travels, uncertified; none found
definitions.sensitivity: samples 0..49 at r = 2, 3, 4 with A in [0,2] x [0,2], twelve shifts, window 21 x 25

public_inputs.code: census.py (sha256 6ad9de8183fc51a3920dd40b93476c89c5f96fbc13dfaf8458ad345dcd981523) beside this file; pysat; 8 workers.
public_inputs.run: census.py from the repository root (--part control, --part main, --part sens); output in artifacts/COMMON-FOLD-20261112-001A/COMMON-FOLD-20261112-001A-E001_periodic_influence/.

forbidden_inputs: Changing seeds, weightings, families, windows, sets or predictions after seeing results
primary_observable: Per r: counts and Wilson intervals of contradiction, base, unsettled; among bases tied, travels, travels uncertified, none found

predictions.A1: r = 1: no base tied or travelling (0 of 200); r = 2: travels/bases Wilson upper bound < 10%
predictions.A2: travels/bases largest at r = 4 or 5, point estimate >= 20%, Wilson lower bound >= 10% there
predictions.A3: tied/bases >= 50% for r >= 6 (Wilson lower bound >= 40% at r = 6); travels/bases <= 20% at r = 7, 8
predictions.A5: contradiction/samples >= 40% at r = 8; never decreasing along prefixes (check)
predictions.A6: sensitivity: travels/bases rises by at most 10 points at each of r = 2, 3, 4
predictions.control: base 16 travels and is tied along no listed shift (check)

decision_rules.A1-A4 hold: travelling bases rare with few kinds, common in the middle, ties near contradiction; global influence typical with many kinds
decision_rules.A2 fails: travelling bases rare at every r under W(r)
decision_rules.A6 fails: rates limited by the search family; reported as such

stop_rule: One run; report and hand off to the referee thread.
runtime: About 10 to 30 minutes on 8 workers; registered in docs/LONG_RUNNING.md; systemd-run --user -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0.
